title: Finish the Latin Square
statement:
An `n x n` grid must be filled with the numbers `1..n` so that every row and every column contains each number exactly once. Some cells are already filled; the cells with `0` are empty. The given numbers may already break the rule.

Count the ways to fill all empty cells so that the whole grid is valid. If the given numbers already break the rule, the answer is `0`.

## Input
The first line contains `n`. Each of the next `n` lines contains `n` integers (`0` for an empty cell).

## Output
Print the number of valid completions.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 5`
- When `n = 5`, at least 5 cells are filled.
